losses: layout: columns and sidebars are linearised in pdftotext's reading order
tables are flattened to one cell per line
words hyphenated across a line break are joined
page boundaries: the form feed between pages is replaced by the {N} marker line

parameters.pageMarker: the line {N} is written before the text of physical page N

sources.notes: System Reference Document 5.2.1, the English PDF on the official SRD page.
